data.rationale: The independent revision-bound command ran once and all 13 behavior cases passed. Scenario coverage is 19 of 21, above the 70% gate; S21 reproduces and verifies repair of the Reviewer r1 rollback defect.
data.exceptions: Branch coverage was not measured because no instrumentation command was authorized. S13 unavailable FD CLI and S20 archived FD rejection remain uncovered; neither is treated as passed. S21 covers the injected index decode failure, not all filesystem faults.
data.residual_risk: Uncovered CLI-unavailable and archived-FD paths, unmeasured branch coverage and filesystem fault varieties outside the S21 injection remain for Reviewer to assess statically.
